props.name: configVersion
props.description: Configuration file version number, supports the following values: v3 currently , v1 deprecated used. All features labeled v3 in this article require the v3 version of app.json to work properly.

props.name: defaultLanguage
props.description: The default language setting for the Mini Program. This value is used as the language of the program when the system cannot find a suitable language to set the program. This value is not recommended to be empty.

props.name: debug
props.description: Mini Program debugging function, supports the following values: true Enable debugging function; false Default value. Turn off the debugging function.

props.name: appId
props.description: The Mini Program "id", "id" is the unique identification of the Mini Program.

props.name: appType
props.description: Mini Program type. The following values are supported: app Mini Program; watchface dial.

props.name: icon
props.description: The path to the Mini Program icon. Reference [Design Specifications - app icons](../designs/visual/icons.md#app-icons). If not passed, use the default icon.

props.name: cover
props.description: Matching images for Mini Program display. In general, dials are used.

props.name: description
props.description: Short description of the Mini Program.

props.name: code
props.description: Mini Program program version number. The default starts from 1. Note: Each version should be larger than the previous one. For example: 12, 13, 2001, etc.

props.name: name
props.description: Semantic version of the Mini Program. It is recommended that versions be recorded in the format x.x.x. For example: 1.0.1.

props.name: type
props.description: The loader type for loading Mini Programs at runtime, supporting the following values: 0 Current value YES Default value. It indicates that the Mini Program is loaded with the loader of the QuickJS-js interpreter, with the suffix .js, 1 indicates that the Mini Program is loaded with the loader of the C interpreter, with the suffix .c, 2 indicates that the Mini Program is loaded with the loader of the QuickJS-bytecode interpreter, with the suffix .bin

props.name: minVersion
props.description: Runtime requirements, this field YES is required to determine the current runtime requirements of the Mini Program; v <= minVersion, cannot be upgraded or installed.

props.name: target
props.description: This is the version of the target SDK, runtime, optionally.

props.name: platforms
props.description: Mini Program running platform device selection.

props.name: designWidth
props.description: The design width of the current view, adjusted using the px runtime; this value depends on the design drafts

props.name: shortcut
props.requiredNote: NO, only valid if appType is app.
props.description: The description of jumping to the Mini Program.

props.name: page
props.requiredNote: YES, required when appType is app.
props.description: The configuration of page in Device App module .

props.name: watch-widget
props.description: The configuration of watchface component module.

props.name: watchface
props.requiredNote: YES, required when appType is watchface.

props.name: setting
props.description: The configuration of Settings App module.

props.name: app-event
props.description: The configuration of System Event Listening.

props.name: appLangType
props.description: Jump to target Mini Program type: 0: js Mini Program; 1: native app.

props.name: appId
props.description: The appid of the Mini Program.

props.name: pages
props.description: Page path, at least one; the default is the first Mini Program entrance.

props.name: main
props.requiredNote: NO(If you don't add it, the default is 1.)
props.description: The watchface which displays in home page.(0:none)

props.name: editable
props.requiredNote: NO(If you don't add it, the default is 0.)

props.name: lockscreen
props.requiredNote: NO(If you don't add it, the default is 0.)

props.name: photoscreen
props.requiredNote: NO(If you don't add it, the default is 0.)

props.name: name
props.description: Device description, named by the developer.

props.name: st
props.description: Screen shape, support s, r, b, Refer to [Screen Adaptation](../guides/framework/device/screen-adaption.md) for details

props.name: sr
props.description: The resolution of the screen, the format is w + number, such as w480 means the screen width 480 px, for details refer to [Screen Adaptation](../guides/framework/device/screen-adaption.md) for details

gaps.description: The configuration of System Event Listening.
